note: Working search query patterns discovered by the scout. WebFetch to individual ATS/board domains (greenhouse, lever, ashby, myworkdayjobs, linkedin, indeed, dice, builtinnyc, wellfound, google.com, metacareers.com, amazon.jobs, bloomberg.avature.net) was blocked by the sandbox egress proxy as of 2026-09-03 in this environment; WebSearch snippets were used instead. careers.twosigma.com, janestreet.com, citadel.com, and careers.datadoghq.com were reachable via WebFetch. Re-check egress access each run in case it changes.
ats_search_queries: site:boards.greenhouse.io devops new york OR remote
site:jobs.ashbyhq.com "platform engineer" new york OR remote
job_board_search_queries: "ci/cd engineer" OR "build engineer" new york senior site:linkedin.com/jobs
"senior site reliability engineer" new york city site:linkedin.com/jobs
site:builtinnyc.com devops OR "platform engineer" OR SRE senior
site:dice.com "site reliability engineer" new york senior
site:ziprecruiter.com "site reliability engineer" new york senior
